Row.Text: Corrects misleading Simplified Chinese gameplay descriptions and missing conditions. Includes Jinja, Mireuksa, Serpent Mound and Brihadeeswarar Temple. No renaming, prose localization or translations for other mods. Changes text only; selected corrections reference Cuchuan's public list.

Replace.Text: 修正简体中文玩法说明中的错谬、适用范围和遗漏条件，包含神社、弥勒寺、巨蟒土丘、布里哈迪希瓦拉神庙等。部分勘误参考徂川公开清单。不改译名，不加入文风润色或其他 Mod 汉化，不改变游戏规则。
